facts.fact: 四个月过去了，Kit 还活着，还在那个小房间醒来；此刻正跟 Lorraine 在花园里弄土。
facts.anchor: It’s been four months since the night everything changed, and somehow, I’m still here. Still breathing and still waking up in that tiny room.

facts.fact: 被注视感近几周越来越频：后颈刺麻、全身僵住，他自认只是个看见太多的多余孩子。
facts.anchor: The past few weeks it’s been happening more and more. That sense of being watched; like someone’s eyes are on me even when I can’t see anyone there. I don’t know what the feeling is supposed to mean. Who would bother watching me? I’m nobody, just the leftover kid who saw too much.

facts.fact: Lorraine 邀他一起去城外大宗采购，他难得真笑、立刻答应。
facts.anchor: Then she looks at me properly. “Do you want to come with me?

facts.fact: Soren 出现在楼梯底，一句「Kit 不离开庄园」终结出行。
facts.anchor: He grunts, deep and final. “Kit doesn’t leave the estate.

facts.fact: Lorraine 被打断后轻声道歉，走向前门离开。
facts.anchor: Softly she says, “Sorry, dear,” before turning and walking away toward the front doors.

facts.fact: Kit 反应过来：几周的被注视感是不是他？又自我否定——boss 哪有空盯自己。
facts.anchor: My eyes go wide. That feeling… the one of being watched these past few weeks… was that him? No. The boss wouldn’t possibly have time to keep an eye on me. Would he?

facts.fact: Soren 手搭上肩，捏了一下，拇指在颈侧多停半秒，说 With me。
facts.anchor: The grip is firm, not rough, but it still sends a jolt straight down my spine. He gives a single squeeze, thumb pressing lightly against the side of my neck for half a second longer than necessary.

facts.fact: 小客厅里 Soren 解下皮带，把 Kit 双腕并在身后紧紧捆住。
facts.anchor: He pulls them together behind my back in one firm movement and starts wrapping the warm, stiff leather around them, tight and deliberate. My breath catches hard in my throat as the belt cinches, binding my wrists securely behind me.

facts.fact: Soren 给了唯一一次说 no 的机会：「I’ll give you one chance to say no, Kit.」
facts.anchor: I’ll give you one chance to say no, Kit.

facts.fact: 奉命睁眼：赤裸上身、晒色肌肉、黑墨缠绕胸臂。
facts.anchor: He’s standing there shirtless. Tanned skin stretched over tight muscle and dark ink that winds across his chest and arms.

facts.fact: Soren 明说：I’m going to fuck you now, Kit.
facts.anchor: I’m going to fuck you now, Kit.

facts.fact: Kit 事后自省：他给了退路，自己却一个字都说不出来。
facts.anchor: He looked me in the eye and offered me the chance to say no, and I just stood here like an idiot who forgot how to speak. I couldn’t even form the word.

facts.fact: 道德锚点闪现：This man killed my parents.
facts.anchor: This man killed my parents.

facts.fact: 绝望合理化：有用好过当没处理的尾巴——我可以又怕又有用，两者能共存。
facts.anchor: Having a use is better than being a loose end, right? I can be scared and still useful; those two things can exist at the same time.

facts.fact: Soren 加了润滑油、放慢重试；Kit 否认体贴：怪物不会体贴，他只是不想听我哭。
facts.anchor: No… monsters aren’t considerate; he probably just doesn’t want to listen to me whining.

facts.fact: Soren 舔咬颈侧留下痕迹，Kit 料定会有藏不住的瘀青。
facts.anchor: I’m pretty sure there’s going to be a visible bruise there later, a dark mark I won’t be able to hide.

facts.fact: Soren 哑声命令：别憋着，我要听见你。
facts.anchor: “Stop hiding,” he demands, his voice coming out cracked and desperate. “I want to hear you.

facts.fact: Kit 未经允许高潮，Soren 一巴掌拍上：我说你可以了吗？
facts.anchor: Did I say you could come?

facts.fact: 结束时 Soren 的声音被彻底击溃，像被这件事饿了很多年。
facts.anchor: The way he sounds… so thoroughly satisfied, almost like he’s been starved of this

facts.fact: Kit 疑惑：他平时是不是根本没时间做这件事？
facts.anchor: Does he not usually have time for sex?
